description: This file defines the EventDataGeneratorAdapterFactory class, a specialized stream provider adapter for generating test events in the Orleans streaming infrastructure using EventHubs. It provides methods for initializing event hub clients, generating event hub partition IDs, managing stream placement, and executing control commands for testing scenarios.

classes.name: EventDataGeneratorAdapterFactory
classes.description: A factory class extending EventHubAdapterFactory to generate mock events for testing, implementing IControllable for command execution.

classes.name: StreamRandomPlacementArg
classes.description: Serializable argument class for randomly placing streams onto queues in the test environment.

methods.name: EventDataGeneratorAdapterFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with various configuration options and dependencies.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the adapter factory, setting the receiver factory.

methods.name: InitEventHubClient
methods.description: Override that does nothing, since the generator does not need a real EventHub client.

methods.name: GetPartitionIdsAsync
methods.description: Returns a task with generated partition IDs based on the options.

methods.name: EHGeneratorReceiverFactory
methods.description: Creates a mock EventHub receiver that generates test data streams.

methods.name: RandomlyPlaceStreamToQueue
methods.description: Assigns streams to queues randomly in the test environment.

methods.name: StopProducingOnStream
methods.description: Stops the data generation process for a given stream.

methods.name: GenerateEventHubPartitions
methods.description: Generates an array of partition ID strings based on the specified count.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes control commands such as placing streams randomly or stopping production.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate and initialize an EventDataGeneratorAdapterFactory with dependencies from the service provider.
